units.name: Vassal King
units.description: May ride in a chariot.  A Vassal king acts as an Army General for all troops of his nationality, being Hurrian, Syrian, Phoenician or Lukka.  They take a Cohesion test upon his death, but do not test if the Hittite C-in-C dies.

units.name: Chief
units.description: May ride in a chariot.  A Vassal king acts as an Army General for all troops of his nationality, being Hurrian, Syrian, Phoenician or Lukka.  They take a Cohesion test upon his death, but do not test if the Hittite C-in-C dies.

units.name: Hittite Chariots
units.description: Hittite Chariots have a driver and a crewman armed with spear, javelins, light armour and shield. Superior Fighters. Light Chariots.They may add a second crewman for +8 points, such a unit may then shoot and fight with an extra D6 for every two Chariots engaging, rounding up. May be Shock Cavalry (against Infantry only) (+4). One unit may be fielded as Guards (C9, Veteran, +3).

units.name: Maryannu Chariots
units.description: Maryannu Chariots have a driver and a crewman armed with bow, light armour and shield. Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Light Chariots. May have spear (+1). Maryannu were the nobilitty of the Hurrian, Syrian or Phoenician subject kingdoms.

units.name: Hittite Chariot Runners
units.description: Hittite Chariot Runners have javelins and shield. Open Order. Escorts. May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of 9 points per base.

units.name: Chariot Runners
units.description: Chariot Runners have javelins and shield. Open Order. Escorts. May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of 8 points per base.

units.name: Cavalry
units.description: Cavalry have a bow. Inferior Fighters. May be fielded as Skirmishers. They appear only in the last 100 or so years of the list.

units.name: Spearmen
units.description: Spearmen have a spear and shield

units.name: Archers
units.description: Archers have a bow. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of five points per base.

units.name: Phoenicians
units.description: Phoenicians have a bow and javelins. May have light armour (+2).

units.name: Lukka (Sea Peoples)
units.description: Lukka have javelins and shield. Warband (rule 3 does not apply). May have light armour (+2) and may be Superior Fighters (+4).

units.name: Habiru
units.description: Habiru have javelins. Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Open Order. Warband (rule 3 does not apply). May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of ten points per base.

units.name: Syrians
units.description: Syrians have javelins. Open Order. May exchange javelins for bow (free). May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of five ponts per base.

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have bow, sling or javelins. Inferior Fighters. Skirmishers. May have shield (+1).
